responsibility: Declares the low-level GENERIC-building layer for the COBOL front end. It defines shorthand macros for GCC type nodes and structured IF/WHILE emission, the translation-unit and function bookkeeping types used by code generation, variable-scope conventions, and the gg_* API for constructing expressions, statements, calls, storage, control flow, and helper data structures in GCC trees.
same_name_distinction: Defines the interface and convenience macros for the low-level gg_* GENERIC builder; unlike gengen.cc, it is the declaration layer exposing types, scope enums, macros, and function prototypes used by the rest of gcc/cobol.
